steps.en: PLUS user asks OCMS to revive the permanent suspension of a paid notice
steps.id: User PLUS meminta OCMS me-revive suspension permanen notice yang sudah dibayar

steps.en: The permanent suspension is revived and the notice is cleared
steps.id: Suspension permanen berhasil di-revive dan notice dibersihkan

steps.en: OCMS checks the notice was paid and qualifies for a refund
steps.id: OCMS mengecek notice sudah dibayar dan berhak refund

steps.en: OCMS creates a refund advice record for the payment
steps.id: OCMS membuat record refund advice untuk pembayaran itu

steps.en: The refund advice can be seen for follow-up
steps.id: Refund advice bisa dilihat untuk ditindaklanjuti
steps.why_en: Refund records show in a daily report and a PLUS list, but the refund screens are switched off.
steps.why_id: Record refund muncul di laporan harian dan daftar PLUS, tetapi layar refund dimatikan.

steps.en: The refund advice is sent to the finance system
steps.id: Refund advice dikirim ke sistem finance
steps.why_en: No code sends refund advice to the finance system; it stays in OCMS.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang mengirim refund advice ke sistem finance; datanya berhenti di OCMS.
